snippet.title: Lost in Voice - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182770/Lost_in_Voice

https://www.beforeyouknowgames.com/

Lost in Voice is a psychological horror game about the cost of genius, the fragility of the human mind, and the terror of losing the one thing that defines you. Enter John’s world. Walk through his memories. And discover why some songs are never meant to be heard.
